properties.name: Kedarnath
properties.description: Kedarnath is a prominent pilgrimage center and is part of twelve auspicious and holy jyothirlingas (a manifestation of Lord Shiva).

properties.name: Madhyamaheshwar
properties.description: The middle (madhya) or belly part or navel (nabhi) of the bull, considered a divine form of Shiva, is worshipped at Madhyamaheshwar temple.

properties.name: Tungnath
properties.description: Tungnath is the highest temple of Lord Shiva in the world attracting both trekkers and pilgrims alike, with the former being more common.

properties.name: Rudranath
properties.description: The face (mukha) of Lord Shiva is worshipped as “Nilkanth Mahadeva” here. Out of all the Panch Kedar, Rudranath is considered to be most difficult.

properties.name: Kalpeshwar
properties.description: In this temple, the matted tress (jata) of Lord Shiva is worship and hence the name Jatadhar or Jateshwar.
